public.title: Course Schedule
public.description: Courses are numbered 0 through courseCount-1. Each pair [course, prerequisite] means prerequisite must be completed before course. Return whether all courses can be completed, including disconnected courses. courseCount is 0 to 200; there are 0 to 2000 distinct valid pairs. Self-dependencies are allowed and make completion impossible.
hints: Courses with no unmet prerequisites can be processed immediately.
A remaining cycle prevents complete topological processing.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Kahn topological traversal removes prerequisite edges. Every course is processed exactly when the graph is acyclic. O(V+E) time and space.
